title: Local decomposition map lands in geometric and Weil subgroups
statement: Let $C_0/k_0$ be a curve in the sense of [d-real-setup], let $j:U_0\hookrightarrow C_0$ be a nonempty open with finite complement $S_0$, and let $s\in S_0$. Put $k_s=\kappa(s)$, $U=U_0\times_{k_0}k$, and $K_s=\operatorname{Frac}(\mathcal O_{C_0,s}^{h})$, where henselization is as in [def-weil-pbc-henselization-at-prime]. Choose an algebraic closure $\overline K_s$ and a compatible algebraic closure $\overline{k_s}$ of the residue field. Write $D_s=\operatorname{Gal}(\overline K_s/K_s)$ and $G_s=\operatorname{Gal}(\overline{k_s}/k_s)$ as in [def-real-boundary-absolute-galois-group], let $r_s:D_s\to G_s$ be the residue homomorphism, put $I_s=\ker(r_s)$, and let $W(K_s)=r_s^{-1}(\langle\Phi_s\rangle)$, where $\Phi_s$ is geometric Frobenius of $k_s$. Choose the geometric point $\bar\eta_s$ over $\operatorname{Spec}K_s\to U_0$, a base point $\bar u$ on $U$, and a path $\gamma:F_{\bar\eta_s}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{\bar u}$ as in [def-real-boundary-decomposition-path]. For a finite etale cover $P$ of $U_0$, an element $z\in|P_{\bar\eta_s}|$ is a $U_0$-morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\overline K_s\to P$, and $\sigma\in D_s$ acts on the local geometric fibre by $a_{\sigma,P}(z)=z\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma)$. With $\pi_1(U_0,\bar u)$ and $\pi_1(U,\bar u)$ the fundamental groups of [def-galois-fibre-functor], the latter viewed in the former through $U\to U_0$, the formula $\theta_s(\sigma)_P=\gamma_P\circ a_{\sigma,P}\circ\gamma_P^{-1}$, equivalently path transport of the map induced by $\operatorname{Spec}K_s\to U_0$ through [lem-galois-pi1-functoriality], defines a continuous homomorphism $\theta_s:D_s\to\pi_1(U_0,\bar u)$. It satisfies $\theta_s(I_s)\subseteq\pi_1(U,\bar u)$ and $\theta_s(W(K_s))\subseteq W(U_0,\bar u)$, with Weil group as in [def-wf-weil-group].
